// diagnostic

E0806

A generator's `return` carries a value (D-STREAMYIELD1)

What

A generator's `return` carries a value (D-STREAMYIELD1)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0806

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0806: tests/ui/yield_return_value.stderr.

Error [E0806]: `count` yields values, so `return` can't carry one
  --> tests/ui/yield_return_value.jet:3:12
    |
  3 |     return 5
    |            ^
 Why: a generator body produces values with `yield`; `return` only ends the stream early
 Fix: write `yield ...;` to hand back a value, or a bare `return;` to end the stream
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0806
